help.card.basic.text: Basic action cards are placed all around the board, on the ink jar track. When you move the ink jar in front of a basic action card, you have 3 choices:
help.card.special.text: When you move the ink jar in front of a special action card, you have 4 choices:
help.action.choice.1: Perform the actions of the action card by that ink space.
help.action.choice.2: Play 1 special action card from your hand, perform its actions, then discard it.
help.action.choice.3: Pay 1 letter to carry out both Option 1 <bold>and</bold> Option 2, in either order.
help.action.choice.4: Pick it up and put it concealed in your hand.
help.card.special.stack: There {count, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} left in the actions stack.
help.card.special.discard: There {count, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in the discard.
help.card.special.shuffle: If the action stack is depleted, the discard pile is shuffled to form a new stack.
help.card.special.hand.you: This card is in your hand.
help.rule.choose.action.descr: After advancing the ink jar to an ink space and paying any associated costs, choose one of the following four options to run it on that ink slot
help.rule.choose.action.option.a: Perform the action(s) on the Basic Action card in this ink space.
help.rule.choose.action.option.b: Play 1 Special Action card from your hand, perform its actions, then discard it face up onto the Special Action discard pile.
help.rule.choose.action.option.c: Pay 1 letter to complete Option A and Option B, in any order.
help.rule.choose.action.option.d: If the Action card next to the ink jar is a Special Action card, take it into your hand.
help.action.split.note: You can only perform one of the 2 actions, unless you have the <alliance>Gdansk alliance card</alliance>.
help.action.3: Gain {quantity} <product/>. In addition, you may use as many of your <bold>active</bold> factories as you like to produce 1 more <product/> per factory flipped.
help.action.3.any: Gain 1 <product/> (<beer/>, <cloth/>, <leather/> or <furniture/>). In addition, you may use as many of your <bold>active</bold> factories as you like to produce 1 more <product/> of your choice per factory flipped.
help.action.5: Pay {cost} <product/> to gain {stars} <star/> from the supply (x{times}).
help.action.6: Exchange any one product from your stock for any one product from the supply (x{times}).
help.action.8: Draw one special action card from the action stack and put it concealed in your hand.
help.action.9: Pay any 2 products to take one factory from the supply and place it, pliers side up, in front of you.
help.action.9.free: Take one factory from the supply free of charge and place it, pliers side up, in front of you.
help.action.10: Move the Prestige marker on the Prestige track one space towards your city name.
help.action.10.rival: Your opponent moves the Prestige marker on the Prestige track one space towards your city name.
help.action.11: Take an Alliance card from the board or from your opponent and place it in front of you. If you take it from your opponent, you must pay 1 letter token.
help.action.12: Buy a ship card by paying the indicated price, then apply any immediate effect.
help.action.13:
<lawsuit/>: Choose one of the 3 face-up lawsuit cards on the game board and pay the legal costs shown in its top left.
Then receive the bonus shown to their right. It always includes "Sway the lawsuit in your favor" by moving its <bold>lawsuit marker 1 space towards your city’s name</bold>.
For lawsuit II and III, you can repeat the action once or twice, but you do not receive the bonus again, you only move the lawsuit marker.
help.action.14: Resolve the lawsuit at the leftmost location if the marker is at least on space 2 on your side, or swap 2 adjacent lawsuit cards, along with their markers.
help.action.15: Flip one of your inactive factories so that its pliers side faces up again (x{count}).
help.action.16: Steal {nbProductsToSteal, select, 1{1 product} other{up to 3 products}} of your choice from your opponent.
help.card.alliance.text:
You can pick up one of the 4 Alliance cards available in the game with the "Conclude an Alliance" action.
Taking an available Alliance is free, taking it from the opponent costs 1 <letter/>.
Each Alliance has an upkeep cost to pay during the off-season.
help.card.alliance.1.text: Each time you perform a Donation action, gain an additional Star token.
help.card.alliance.2.text: When you perform a "Gain Prestige" action, you can pay one Furniture item to repeat the action immediately. However, this same benefit cannot be repeated with this card.
help.card.alliance.3.text: When using a split action card, you can perform the actions on both halves of the card, in any order.
help.card.alliance.4.text: When you perform a "Draw a Special Action Card" action, you can pay one Beer to repeat the action immediately. But this same benefit cannot be repeated with this card.
help.card.alliance.5.text: When you perform a "Progress in lawsuit" action, you can pay one product of your choice to repeat the action immediately. However, this same benefit cannot be repeated with this card.
help.card.alliance.6.text: Each time you perform a Production or Gift action during which you gain at least one cloth, gain one additional cloth. Note that this only applies to actions that are specifically titled "Production" or "Gift."
help.card.alliance.7.text: Each time you perform a Production or Gift action during which you gain at least one leather, gain one additional leather. Note that this only applies to actions that are specifically titled "Production" or "Gift."
help.card.alliance.8.text: Each time you perform a Production or Donation action in which you gain at least one piece of furniture, gain one additional piece of furniture. Note that this only applies to actions that are specifically titled "Production" or "Donation."
help.card.alliance.win: You <bold>immediately win the game</bold> if you have <bold>all 4 alliance cards</bold>.
help.card.lawsuit.text:
There are <bold>7 Lawsuit cards</bold> in each game. Players can use the <lawsuit/> action to advance in their favor one of the 3 lawsuits available on the board.
During the off-season, when the ink jar marker has circled the board, <bold>Lawsuit I (the leftmost) is resolved</bold>: if the lawsuit marker is at least on <bold>space 2</bold> on your side, you win the lawsuit by taking the card, and the associated reward.
If the marker is on space 1, you win a <star/> token.
help.card.lawsuit.win: You <bold>immediately win the game</bold> when you win your <bold>3rd lawsuit</bold>.
help.card.ship.text: Ship cards give you bonuses, as well as stars for calculating points at the end of the game.
help.card.ship.effect.production: When you perform the "Production" action, gain 1 <product/>.
help.card.ship.15.effect: When you win a lawsuit, gain 2 <star/>.
help.card.ship.16.effect: When you perform the "Gain Prestige" action, you can pay 2 <beer/> to perform the action again.
help.card.ship.17.effect: When you move the ink jar token forward, you can move forward one more space for free.
help.card.ship.18.effect: When you have to choose between the basic action and the special action, you can choose both without spending a letter.
help.card.ship.win: You <bold>immediately win the game</bold> if you have <bold>3 more ships than your opponent</bold>.
help.card.stars: At the end of the game, if no player achieves an instant win, this card is worth {stars} <star/>.
help.card.ship.21.stars: At the end of the game, if no player achieves an instant victory, this card is worth 1 <star/> per ship the player owns.
help.game.overview.1: On your turn, you must first advance the ink jar in a clockwise direction along the ink spaces of the game board. You must advance it at least to the next ink space, but may advance it as far as you like if you can afford to.
help.game.overview.2: If you advance the ink jar by one or two ink spaces, you don’t have to pay anything. From the third space onward, however, you must pay for the movement: The third space costs one product, the fourth space also costs one product, and each additional space beyond the fourth costs two products. Which products you pay for is up to you, but you can’t move onto an ink space if you can’t pay for it.
help.game.overview.choice: After advancing the ink jar to an ink space and paying any costs for doing so, choose one of the following 4 options to carry out on that ink space:
help.game.overview.instant.win.1: You have <bold>3 more ship cards than your opponent</bold>
help.game.overview.instant.win.4: The prestige marker <bold>has reached your city</bold>
help.game.overview.end.descr: If the game doesn’t end due to a player pulling off an instant win, it ends at the end of the off-season in which at least one of the listed end conditions has been met:
help.game.overview.end.4: All <bold>12 star tokens</bold> have been taken.
help.game.overview.score.descr: In the latter case, the winner is determined by means of the following star scoring:
help.game.overview.score.1: Add up the stars on the <bold>ship, lawsuit, and alliance cards</bold> you own.
help.game.overview.score.2: If the prestige marker is on <bold>your side</bold> of the track, also add the dark stars on its space.
help.game.overview.score.3: Finally, add to your total the <bold>star tokens</bold> in front of you.
help.game.overview.score.win: The person with the highest total wins the game. In the event of a tie, <bold>the person with the Bell token wins</bold>.
help.off.season.overview.descr: If you move the Ink Jar <bold>beyond the bell</bold>, first finish moving it (advancing it to the Ink space you intend to use). As usual, pay any costs for this move. However, before you choose an option, the game is paused and the Off-season is performed. To mark this pause, take the Bell token and place it in front of you. Then perform the following actions:
help.off.season.overview.action.1: For each Alliance card in front of you, choose either to pay its upkeep cost shown in its upper left corner next to the bell icon, or to replace it on one of the free Alliance spaces on the board.
help.off.season.overview.action.2: The person with the most Ship cards can perform the "Gain Prestige" action. In the event of a tie, nothing happens.
help.off.season.overview.action.3: If you have any Ship cards that grant income (cards 6-10), gain that income.
help.off.season.overview.action.4: The person on the side of the Prestige track where the Prestige marker is located wins:
help.off.season.overview.action.4.1: the income indicated on the marker box
help.off.season.overview.action.4.2: each income shown on the boxes between the marker and the Bell icon.
help.off.season.overview.action.5: Look at the track and the lawsuit marker in position I
help.off.season.overview.action.5.1: If the marker is on space 0, return this lawsuit card to the game box.
help.off.season.overview.action.5.2: If the marker is on space 1 on either side, the person on that side gains a Star token from the supply. Then, return the lawsuit card to the game box.
help.off.season.overview.action.5.3: If the marker is on space 2, 3, or 4 on either side, the person on that side wins the lawsuit. That person wins the lawsuit card, places it face up in front of them, and earns the bonus shown at the bottom of the card.
help.off.season.overview.action.6: Discard the Special Action cards from the 4 dark yellow-bordered spaces face up onto the Special Action discard pile. Then, draw 4 new cards from the action pile and place one face up on each of the 4 dark yellow-bordered spaces.
help.off.season.overview.action.7: Reactivate all your inactive factories by turning them over with the gripper side up.
help.off.season.overview.action.8: Finally, check if at least one of the following endgame conditions has been met:
help.off.season.overview.action.8.1: There are no more Ship cards left on the board.
help.off.season.overview.action.8.2: There are no more lawsuit cards on the board.
help.off.season.overview.action.8.3: There are no more Factory tokens in the supply.
help.off.season.overview.action.8.4: There are no more Star tokens in the supply.
help.off.season.overview.descr.end: If at least one of these conditions is met, the game ends. Determine who wins the game by counting the stars. Otherwise, the person with the Bell token returns it to its place on the board. They then continue their turn by choosing one of the usual options from the Ink space where they had placed the Ink Jar before the Off-season was interrupted.
help.bell.text: When a player triggers the off-season by moving the ink jar beyond the bell token, he gets this token back while the off-season is resolved.
help.bell.tie-breaker: In the event of a tie in the number of stars at the end of the game, the player with the bell token wins.
product.text:
Whenever you would gain a product from the supply that is not there any more, take it instead from <bold>the stock of your rival</bold> if your rival has <bold>more products of that type</bold> in their stock than you do. If this is not the case, you must forgo that product.
The same is true for letters.
help.letter.use.2: perform both the actions of the basic card and the actions of a special card.
help.letter.use.3: pay to advance in some lawsuits.
help.letter.use.4: exchange any one product from your stock for any one product from the supply.
button.letter.swap: Pay one letter to exchange one product
help.factory.supply:
There {count, plural, one{is # factory} other{are # factories}} left in the supply.
At the end of the off-season, <bold>if the supply is empty</bold>, the game is over.
help.factory.text:
Factories can be used to produce an additional resource during "production" actions.
When an active factory is used to produce an additional resource, it is flipped to its inactive side.
Factories are reactivated during the off-season, after the ink jar marker has circled the board.
help.star.supply:
There {count, plural, one{is # star token} other{are # star tokens}} left in the supply.
At the end of the off-season, <bold>if the supply is empty</bold>, the game is over.
help.star.text:
Star tokens can be earned from certain ships or lawsuits, or from "Donation" actions.
At the end of the game, if no player has won an immediate victory, the player with the most stars on his cards, tokens and prestige track wins.
help.prestige.text:
When a player performs the <prestige/> action, he moves the prestige marker one space towards his city's name on the prestige track.
During the off-season, if the prestige marker is on your side, <bold>you earn the income indicated</bold> on the square where it is, as well as all squares between that position and the center position.
At the end of the game, if the prestige marker is on your side of the board, you win the number of stars indicated on its space.
help.prestige.win: You immediately win the game if the prestige marker reaches your city's name.
help.lawsuit-marker.text:
You can move the lawsuit marker to your side using the <lawsuit/> action.
When resolving a lawsuit, if the marker is in position 2, 3 or 4, the corresponding player wins the lawsuit.

history.alliance.end: {player} returns the alliance with <card>{alliance}</card> to the board.
history.ship.most: The player with the most ships earns prestige:
history.ship.income: Players gain income from their ships:
history.off-season.end: {player} returns the bell and takes their action:
tuto.step.1:
In Rival Cities, Altona and Hamburg are two neighboring and rival cities. Produce goods, charter ships, form alliances, and file lawsuits to become the most influential city!
In this tutorial game, you play as Altona.
tuto.step.2: In the game, there are four types of products: <bold>Beer</bold>, <bold>Cloth</bold>, <bold>Leather</bold>, and <bold>Furniture</bold>.
tuto.step.3:
You are the first player. You start the game with a <bold>Beer</bold> token (on the left) and another product token of your choice.
Take a <bold>Furniture</bold> token.
tuto.step.4: On your turn, you must first move the <bold>ink jar</bold> across the board.
tuto.step.5: Moving forward to the next 2 spaces is free.
tuto.step.6:
Moving to the 3rd space costs 1 product token of your choice, and the 4th space costs another product.
Each additional space then costs 2 more products of your choice!
tuto.step.7: Move the ink jar here, for free.
tuto.step.8:
After moving the ink jar, you perform the associated action.
This action offers you two choices: produce beer or cloth.
tuto.step.10:
Each player also starts the game with a <bold>factory</bold>.
On this side, it is active. Once used, it is flipped to its inactive side, and will only become available again after the <bold>Off-season</bold>, when the inkwell has made a full turn around the board.
tuto.step.11:
This action also allows you to use as many active factories as you like to produce additional Beers.
You start the game with one active factory.
Produce one additional Beer.
tuto.step.13: He advanced the ink jar on this action, which allows him to take an Alliance card.
tuto.step.14:
Here are the 4 Alliance cards (they change with each game).
Taking an available alliance is free.
Taking an alliance from your opponent costs 1 letter: <letter/>.
tuto.step.15:
Each Alliance grants a permanent benefit, but be careful: during the <bold>Off-season</bold>, you must pay an upkeep cost for each Alliance card you wish to keep!
<italic>At any time, click on a card to see its effect.</italic>
tuto.step.16: If a player has all <bold>4</bold> Alliance cards, <bold>they immediately win the game</bold>!
tuto.step.17:
Your opponent has taken the alliance with Oslo.
Your turn. Move the ink jar here.
tuto.step.18:
This action allows you to build a factory for 2 products.
Take a factory from the supply and pay for it with 2 Beers.
tuto.step.20: Your opponent has produced 3 pieces of furniture, thanks to his factory and his alliance with Oslo.
tuto.step.21: It's your turn. Move the ink jar forward 2 spaces.
tuto.step.22: This action card is a <bold>Special Action</bold>, recognizable by its yellow background and folded corner.
tuto.step.23: When you land on a Special Action space, you can take it into your hand.
tuto.step.24:
Special Action cards in your hand can be played later, <bold>instead of a basic action</bold>.
It is also possible to pay 1 <letter /> to perform a basic action <bold>AND</bold> a special action in the same turn!
tuto.step.26: Your opponent paid 3 Furniture to charter this <bold>Ship</bold>.
tuto.step.27: This ship immediately allowed him to gain 2 <bold>Prestige</bold> points: <prestige/>. He therefore moved the Prestige marker <bold>2 spaces towards Hamburg</bold>.
tuto.step.28: During the off-season, the most prestigious city provides income: currently, this would be 1 Beer for your opponent.
tuto.step.29: If a player brings the Prestige marker <bold>to the end of the track</bold> onto the space with their city's name, <bold>they immediately win the game</bold>!
tuto.step.30: Your opponent now has a ship. Having more Ships than your opponent during the off-season allows you to gain <bold>1 additional Prestige point</bold>.
tuto.step.31: Finally, having <bold>3 more ships</bold> than your opponent allows you to <bold>immediately win the game</bold>!
tuto.step.32: It's your turn. Move the ink jar forward 2 spaces.
tuto.step.33: The <balance /> action allows you to <bold>progress in a lawsuit</bold>.
tuto.step.34:
Here are the <bold>3 lawsuit cards</bold> available.
To progress on any of the cards, you must pay the cost indicated on the card.
tuto.step.35: Pay 2 beers to take 1 Cloth and move the lawsuit marker one space towards Altona.
tuto.step.36: As you progress through lawsuits II and III, you can pay additional products to advance the lawsuit marker one or two additional spaces.
tuto.step.37:
The position of the lawsuit marker on lawsuit I can allow you to win the lawsuit during the off-season, or by performing the <decision /> Court Decision action.
To win a lawsuit, the marker must be on space 2, 3, or 4 on your side.
Winning <bold>3 lawsuits</bold> allows you to <bold>immediately win the game</bold>!
tuto.step.38:
The game continues like this. When the <bold>ink jar</bold> passes the <bold>bell token</bold>, it's <bold>off-season</bold>.
Click on the associated game aid for details on how to resolve the off-season!
tuto.step.39:
As a reminder, there are 4 ways to win an immediate victory:
• Have all 4 Alliance cards
• Have 3 more Ship cards than your opponent
• Have won 3 lawsuit cards
• Have reached your City name with the Prestige marker
tuto.step.40: Click on this game aid to remind yourself of the victory conditions, and to discover the end-of-game conditions if no one wins immediately: in this case, the player with the most stars on their Alliances, Ships, lawsuits, Prestige track and Star tokens wins the game.
tuto.step.41: Now it's your turn: make Altona the most prestigious Rival City!
